name: Abbasid Revolution
short_desc: A revolt beginning in Khurasan overthrows the Umayyad caliphate and brings the Abbasids to power.
date_note: Open revolt began at Merv in 747; the Abbasids defeated the Umayyads in 750. Umayyad rule later continued separately in al-Andalus.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. Explains the political transition into a major era of Islamic history rather than leaving the Islamic Golden Age disconnected from its institutional setting. Evidence and date rationale: Open revolt began at Merv in 747 and the Abbasids defeated the Umayyads in 750. This records the revolution, not the entire later Abbasid period or the separate survival of Umayyad rule in al-Andalus. Primary evidence: https://islamicceramics.ashmolean.org/Abbasid/history.htm. Cached Wikipedia introduction and lead image provide separately attributed background. Remains review, not comprehensive factual approval.
